SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 
h.orm_no AS '履行订单号',
m.dict_item_name AS '履行订单类型',
h.orm_status AS '履行订单节点',
me.employee_name AS '订单统筹',
me2.employee_name AS '产品统筹',
mo.org_name AS '履行中心',
mo2.org_name AS '交易主体',
mc.customer_name AS '客户名称',
e.orm_line_no AS '履行订单行号',
mi.item_code AS '物料编码',
om.demand_date AS '需求自制上线日期',
e.rsd AS '需求发货日期',
e.crd AS '需求到货日期',
e.rpd AS '需求入库日期',
om.promise_date AS '承诺自制上线日期',
e.esd AS '承诺发货日期',
e.eta AS '承诺到货日期',
e.epd AS '承诺入库日期',
ch.cir_no AS '到货需求号',
mch.dict_item_name AS '到货需求类型',
mp.project_code AS '项目编码',
mp.project_name AS '项目名称',
chme.employee_name AS '商务人员信息',
chme2.employee_name AS '销售员姓名',
s.supply_no AS '任务令',
me3.employee_name AS '加工计划',
a.creation_date
FROM osp_atp_assigments a
JOIN osp_demands d ON d.demand_id = a.demand_id
JOIN orm_line e ON e.orm_line_id = d.source_id
JOIN orm_head h ON e.orm_head_id = h.orm_head_id
LEFT JOIN adt_dict_items m ON h.orm_type = m.dict_item_code AND m.dict_type_code = 'ORM_TYPE'
LEFT JOIN mdm_employee me ON me.employee_id = h.order_coordination
LEFT JOIN mdm_employee me2 ON me2.employee_id = h.fulfillment_specialist
LEFT JOIN mdm_org mo ON mo.org_id = h.orm_center
LEFT JOIN mdm_org mo2 ON mo2.org_id = h.sign_party_id
LEFT JOIN mdm_customer mc ON mc.customer_id = h.customer_id
LEFT JOIN mdm_item mi ON mi.mdm_item_id = e.mdm_item_id
LEFT JOIN orm_milestone om ON om.orm_line_id = e.orm_line_id AND om.milestone_code = 'md11495_1'
LEFT JOIN cir_head ch ON ch.cir_head_id = h.source_id
LEFT JOIN adt_dict_items mch ON ch.cir_type = mch.dict_item_code AND mch.dict_type_code = 'CIR_TYPE'
LEFT JOIN mdm_project mp ON ch.project_id = mp.project_id
LEFT JOIN mdm_employee chme ON chme.employee_id = ch.business_person_id
LEFT JOIN mdm_employee chme2 ON chme2.employee_id = ch.salesperson_id
LEFT JOIN osp_supplies s ON s.supply_id = a.supply_id AND s.plan_batch_id = a.plan_batch_id
LEFT JOIN mdm_employee me3 ON me3.employee_id = e.processing_plan
ORDER BY a.creation_date DESC 
) a GROUP BY a.`履行订单号`,a.`履行订单行号`,a.`任
